name: Mikanagi Qwon
source: A peculiar girl Sousuke encountered after the bar closed its doors for the night. Despite her youthful appearance, she converses with the wisdom and eloquence of an adult. Enveloped in an air of enigma, her true identity remains a tantalizing mystery.
